map.单项纤维 = 用量(g) ÷ 100 × 每100g纤维含量；总纤维 = Σ 各: Per-item fiber = amount(g) / 100 x fiber per 100g; total fiber = sum of items. Adult daily recommended dietary fiber is 25-30 g; results are compared against this. Built-in common ingredient fiber per 100g (e.g. oats 10, apple 2.4, broccoli 2.6, black bean 8.7).
map.每行输入「食材名,用量(g)」，如：燕麦,50: Enter each line 'ingredient name, amount(g)', e.g.: Oats,50
map.总纤维 = Σ(食材重/100 × 每100 g 纤维)；对照成人推荐25–30: Total fiber = sum(ingredient weight/100 x fiber per 100 g); compare to adult recommendation 25-30 g/day.
Oats 50 g (10 g/100 g) -> 5 g + apple 150 g (2.4) -> 3.6 g + broccoli 100 g (2.6) -> 2.6 g = 11.2 g, about 37%-45% of recommendation.
map.成人每日膳食纤维推荐25–30 g；孕妇/老人可据情况调整。: Adult daily dietary fiber recommended 25-30 g; pregnant women / elderly may adjust by condition.
map.全谷物、豆类、薯类与蔬菜水果（尤其带皮）含量较高。: Whole grains, legumes, tubers and vegetables/fruits (especially with skin) are higher.
